info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Routes-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Routes API provides an interface for obtaining detailed information about shipping routes associated with logistics shipments. This API allows users to query existing routes, facilitating better planning and optimization of shipment logistics. It is ideal for logistics managers, supply chain analysts, and any stakeholders involved in transportation operations. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their route management and improve overall shipping efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the routes for shipments, providing essential information about the path taken by packages. Utilize this to optimize logistics and enhance delivery efficiency.
